headline: Alicorp Acquires Flora Food Group Latin American Operations
summary: Alicorp closed a transaction to acquire Flora Food Group's business across approximately 30 territories in South America, Central America, and the Caribbean for an enterprise value exceeding $150 million.
why: Strategic acquisitions allow consumer goods companies to expand geographic reach, consolidate market share in key categories like spreads, and capture operational synergies.

impacts.name: Alicorp
impacts.why: The acquisition expands Alicorp's footprint and product categories across Latin America.
